name: anthropic_message
description: Send a message to Claude and get a response. Full control over model, system prompt, temperature, tools, and tool_choice.

name: anthropic_message_with_tools
description: Multi-turn Claude conversation with automatic tool-use handling. Runs up to max_turns.

name: anthropic_count_tokens
description: Count the number of tokens in a prompt before sending it to Claude

name: anthropic_get_model
description: Get details about a specific Claude model

name: anthropic_create_batch
description: Create a batch of Claude API requests to process asynchronously at reduced cost

name: anthropic_get_batch
description: Get the status and results of a batch request

name: anthropic_list_batches
description: List all batch jobs in the Anthropic account

name: anthropic_get_batch_results
description: Download the results of a completed batch job as a list of responses

name: anthropic_list_files
description: List all files uploaded to the Anthropic API

name: anthropic_get_file
description: Get metadata about a specific file uploaded to the Anthropic API

name: anthropic_delete_file
description: Delete a file from the Anthropic API

name: anthropic_get_usage
description: Get API usage and cost statistics for the Anthropic account

name: anthropic_quick_ask
description: Quick single question to Claude Haiku for fast, cheap responses. Great for classification, extraction, and simple tasks.
